findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/L2/Covariance.lean:52` declares `theorem covariance_eq_of_identDistrib_pair ... (h : IdentDistrib ...)`; Mathlib puts the analogous methods in `namespace IdentDistrib`, e.g. `mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/IdentDistrib.lean:185` `theorem integral_eq (h : IdentDistrib f g μ ν)` and `:288` `theorem variance_eq (h : IdentDistrib f g μ ν)`. Naming convention: axiomatic/common properties are namespaced by the operation, and theorem names describe the conclusion while hypotheses go after `of` only when needed.
findings.fix: Move it to the `IdentDistrib` namespace and name it `IdentDistrib.covariance_eq` (or another `IdentDistrib.*` name if disambiguation is needed), then call it as `(hX.identDistrib_pair hX_meas hij hkl).covariance_eq`.
findings.issue: `covariance_eq_of_identDistrib_pair` is a public theorem whose main argument is an `IdentDistrib` proof, but it is introduced as a free `TauCeti.Probability` theorem instead of an `IdentDistrib` theorem, so users cannot find or use it by the same dot-notation pattern as the adjacent API.

summary: One public covariance transfer lemma is still placed outside the `IdentDistrib` namespace despite matching Mathlib's method-style `IdentDistrib` API.
